title: Compatible boundaries of relative Mayer Vietoris triangles
statement: Let $X',X,S',S$ be schemes with a cartesian square $g':X'\to X$, $f':X'\to S'$, $f:X\to S$, $g:S'\to S$ [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume $S,S'$ affine and $f$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume the derived module categories of all schemes exist [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $K\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)$, $K'\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_{X'})$, and $\psi:Lg'^*K\to K'$. Let $U,V\subseteq X$ be quasi-compact opens covering $X$, with $U\cap V$ quasi-compact. Put $W'=g'^{-1}W$, $F=Lg^*Rf_*$ and $G=Rf'_*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Use the fixed open adjunctions, triangles $T(\delta),T'(\delta')$ and maps $a_0,a_2,a_{UV}$ of [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components]. There exist connecting morphisms $\delta:Rj_{U\cap V,*}r_{U\cap V}K\to K[1]$, $\delta':Rj_{(U\cap V)',*}r_{(U\cap V)'}K'\to K'[1]$ and shift-commutation structures $c_F,c_G$ such that $T(\delta),T'(\delta')$ and their images $F(T(\delta)),G(T'(\delta'))$ are distinguished, and $F(\delta);c_F(K);a_0[1]=a_{UV};G(\delta');c_G(K')$. No first or second commutativity square or triangle morphism is asserted.
